findings.message: 7 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Emisi tertanam produk, dihitung dari dokumen yan" → 5 lines (12 words, 66px); "Dari tumpukan dokumen ke laporan yang bisa diaud" → 3 lines (8 words, 48px); "Angka tidak selalu berada di tempat yang sama." → 3 lines (8 words, 48px); "Dua peran, satu alur yang tidak bisa dilompati." → 3 lines (8 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 9 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Untuk eksportir ke Uni Eropa" (pill) above "Emisi tertanam produk, dihitung dari dok"; "Cara kerja" above "Dari tumpukan dokumen ke laporan yang bi"; "Pembacaan dokumen" above "Angka tidak selalu berada di tempat yang"; "Peran" above "Dua peran, satu alur yang tidak bisa dil"; "Akun perusahaan" above "Menyiapkan dan mengajukan data"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "AUDIT OS", "E = data aktivitas × faktor emisi × GWP", "SEE = (E langsung + E hulu) × porsi ÷ to", "AUDIT OS"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "01", "02"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.i-beam → linear-gradient(rgba(200, 240, 90, 0) 0%, rgba(200, 240, 90, 0.22) 70%, rgba(200, 240, 90, 0.95) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 16 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.accent → rgb(4, 4, 4) 3px 4px 0px 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset | a.btn.on-dark → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) 3px 4px 0px 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) 0px 1px 0px 0px ins | li → rgb(12, 12, 11) 3px 4px 0px 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 27 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.stats.hero-ui 1184px | section.lp-standards 1440px | section#pembacaan.lp-sec.alt 1440px | div.rowx 424px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 12 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (text #f5f3ef).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "No. faktur" 3.7:1 needs 4.5:1; "Jenis BBM" 3.7:1 needs 4.5:1; "Harga satuan" 3.7:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Instrument Sans, Gloock, JetBrains Mono).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.5:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 1 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 27 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "0,000" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Emisi tertanam produk, dihitung dari dokumen yan" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "0,562" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "Dari tumpukan dokumen ke laporan yang bisa diaud" (screen 2, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "0,000" (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "0,562" (screen 2, 100% over a picture); "1,006" (screen 4, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.
